_comment: ACTIVE branch protection profile for `main`. Apply with: gh api -X PUT repos/:owner/:repo/branches/main/protection --input .github/branch-protection.json. required_pull_request_reviews is intentionally null because the repo currently has exactly one CODEOWNER and GitHub blocks self-approval -- requiring reviews would deadlock every PR. The drop-in replacement profile that flips reviews on (for the day a second CODEOWNER lands) is `.github/branch-protection.with-second-reviewer.json`; tests/test_branch_protection_drift.py asserts the two profiles stay byte-identical outside required_pull_request_reviews. See annuity_model/docs/CODEOWNERS_RATIONALE.md, section 'Second-CODEOWNER upgrade path', for the activation checklist. Keep the contexts list in lockstep with the job names in .github/workflows/ -- if you rename a job here, rename it there in the same PR, otherwise PRs will hang forever waiting on a status that never reports.
